name: BIA Edge
description:
BIA Edge is a retrieval layer that gives AI agents citation-grade access to the U.S. immigration-law corpus. It covers published BIA precedent plus roughly 248,000 unpublished BIA decisions and 167,000 AAO non-precedent decisions, federal circuit, district, and Supreme Court immigration cases, Attorney General and OCAHO decisions, the INA and Title 8 and related CFR, the USCIS Policy Manual, FAM and agency guidance, state and federal criminal codes for crimmigration screening, visa bulletins, and EOIR statistics.

Its read-only tools cover exact citation lookup, case and statute search, case-validity and treatment signals, unpublished and immigrant-favorable decision search, doctrine and related-precedent context, pinpoint source-text passages, and state and federal criminal-code screening. BIA Edge is a corpus-and-retrieval layer designed for the agent to verify source text and synthesize the work product; it does not produce final legal conclusions on its own.

Built for immigration attorneys and the AI tools they already use. Access requires a BIA Edge account (request at https://biaedge.com/mcp-access); authentication is OAuth or an issued API key. The corpus is updated continuously, and freshness is reported through a corpus-status tool.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BIA Edge to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BIA Edge to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.biaedge.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BIA Edge MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BIA Edge lists 39 MCP tools, including check_validity, expand_precedent_context, fetch, find_in_reference, find_in_statute, get_case_by_citation, get_citations, get_district_court_decision, get_doctrine_by_case, get_doctrine_family, get_document, and get_most_cited.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BIA Edge?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BIA Edge in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: Does BIA Edge MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: BIA Edge requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BIA Edge is developed by BIA Edge. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
